original_question: A 66-year-old woman with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is brought to the emergency department because of fever, body aches, malaise, and a dry cough. She has smoked one pack of cigarettes daily for 30 years but quit smoking 1 year ago. She lives with her daughter and her granddaughter, who attends daycare. Her temperature is 38.1°C (101°F). Physical examination shows bilateral conjunctivitis, rhinorrhea, and erythematous tonsils without exudates. Further testing confirms infection with an enveloped orthomyxovirus. Administration of a drug with which of the following mechanisms of action is most appropriate?

base.stage_1: A 66-year-old woman with a history of COPD presents to the emergency department complaining of fever, body aches, malaise, and a dry cough.
base.stage_2: The patient's temperature is 38.1°C (101°F). Physical examination reveals bilateral conjunctivitis, rhinorrhea, and erythematous tonsils without exudates. Auscultation of the lungs reveals mild wheezing bilaterally.
base.stage_3: A rapid antigen test of a nasopharyngeal swab is positive for influenza A.
base.stage_4: Viral culture of the nasopharyngeal swab confirms the presence of influenza A, sensitive to neuraminidase inhibitors.

counterfactuals.alteration_description: The absence of fever and presence of purulent sputum production argues against influenza.
counterfactuals.stage_1: A 66-year-old woman with a history of COPD presents to the emergency department complaining of fever, body aches, malaise, and a dry cough.
counterfactuals.stage_2: The patient's temperature is 36.9°C (98.4°F). Physical examination reveals bilateral conjunctivitis, rhinorrhea, and erythematous tonsils without exudates. Auscultation of the lungs reveals mild wheezing bilaterally, and the patient is producing purulent sputum.
counterfactuals.stage_3: A rapid antigen test of a nasopharyngeal swab is positive for influenza A.
counterfactuals.stage_4: Viral culture of the nasopharyngeal swab confirms the presence of influenza A, sensitive to neuraminidase inhibitors.
